recovery.prediction_equation: predicted final recovery = current percentage alive - predicted additional loss
recovery.snapshot_sampling: Days 7, 14, 21, and 28 plus the latest eligible pre-outcome snapshot
recovery.label_definition: Population on the last recorded daily date divided by beginning inventory; capstone recovery proxy
recovery.status: Experimental - transparent age-band remaining-loss baseline retained

nested_validation.outer_split: Leave one complete harvest cycle out
nested_validation.inner_split: Leave one complete remaining harvest cycle out
nested_validation.preprocessing_scope: Imputation, scaling, feature handling and tuning fitted inside each training fold
nested_validation.independent_unit: Building-cycle; repeated snapshots receive equal total training weight

recovery.rolling_origin_note: Secondary prospective check: train only on earlier cycles and predict the next recorded cycle.
recovery.secondary_validation_note: Diagnostic only: leaves out one building-cycle while other buildings from the same harvest cycle remain in training.
recovery.feature_importance_interpretation: Held-out permutation importance shows predictive association and model reliance, not causality.
limitations: Only 25 independent building-cycle recovery outcomes are available.
The recovery label is a last-recorded proxy, not a verified harvest event.
Environmental evidence is incomplete in part of the history.
Target-side classification is not trusted unless it beats the majority baseline.

weight.training_source: FARM HARVEST DATA.xlsx + Farm Performance Summary.xlsx (final average weight only)
weight.label_definition: Building-level Ave Live Weight (kg) from Farm Performance Summary.xlsx, used directly as the final-harvest label
weight.status: Experimental — champion gates failed; transparent baseline used operationally

nested_validation.outer_split: Leave one complete harvest cycle out
nested_validation.inner_split: Leave one complete remaining harvest cycle out
nested_validation.preprocessing_scope: Imputation, scaling and tuning are fitted inside each training fold
nested_validation.independent_unit: Building-cycle; repeated snapshots receive equal total training weight

weight.secondary_validation_note: Diagnostic only: leaves out one building-cycle while other buildings from the same harvest cycle can remain in training. This is easier and more optimistic than prospective whole-cycle validation.

candidate_registry.reason: Unavailable locally because the required OpenMP runtime is missing; run in Linux/CI before release if XGBoost evidence is required

weight.selection_note: Select the simplest candidate within 5% of the best cycle-balanced MAE.

unavailable_candidates.xgboost: Not run in this local build because the required macOS OpenMP runtime (libomp) is unavailable.

weight.feature_importance_interpretation: Held-out permutation importance shows predictive reliance and association. It is not causal evidence and cannot justify treatment-size claims.

day35_weight.prediction_equation: projected Day 35 weight = latest measured weight + predicted remaining gain
day35_weight.label_definition: Observed building average bodyweight recorded on production Day 35

nested_validation.outer_split: Leave one complete harvest cycle out
nested_validation.inner_split: Leave one complete remaining harvest cycle out
nested_validation.optimization_metric: Cycle-balanced MAE in projected Day 35 weight
nested_validation.preprocessing_scope: Imputation, scaling, checkpoint features and tuning fitted inside each training fold
nested_validation.independent_unit: Building-cycle; four checkpoint rows receive equal total training weight

day35_weight.rolling_origin_note: Secondary prospective check: train only on earlier cycles and predict the next recorded cycle.
day35_weight.secondary_validation_note: Diagnostic only: leaves out one building-cycle while other buildings from the same harvest cycle remain in training.

selected_method_drivers.direction: A higher current weight raises the projection.
Earlier checkpoints normally have more remaining gain.

day35_weight.feature_importance_interpretation: Held-out permutation importance shows predictive association and model reliance, not causality.
day35_weight.historical_remaining_gain_definition: Within each training fold, calculate observed Day 35 weight minus the checkpoint weight, average that remaining gain for the same checkpoint, and add it to the current building's measured weight.
limitations: Only 31 independent Day 35 building outcomes are available.
Only five historical outcomes reached the 1.8 kg milestone.
Weight sampling and environmental coverage vary across cycles.
The projection is not a guarantee of target attainment.
